name: Matsudo Minami
source:
"*sniff sniff*, you smell just like my papa."

A very cute elf mage. [url=/c113636]Sensei[/url] gets soothed just by looking at her too. The laid-back way she speaks is probably part of her cuteness. Also, physically, everyone thinks she is "amazing".
And now that I've introduced you to her basic information, let's get to the important stuff... well, there are some things that … you shouldn't know!
No, she is probably better compared to the other girls.
However, when it comes to the mysteries of the XR world and its unknown forces, her eyes have a different glow, and she does not care how she works in solving these mysteries or the secondary damage she may cause with her experiments.
In other words, she is like a pesky researcher, but her absolute cuteness has a charm that neutralizes all problems. Well, it's only sensei who is inwardly fussing about how cute and pretty she is.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Elf
Height: 146 cm
Occupation: Mage
